zooInfo: Baku Zoological Park is a modern and family-friendly wildlife park located in the capital of Azerbaijan. This zoo is a home to animals from different parts of the world and provides them with safe habitats, professional veterinary care, and balanced nutrition. Its main mission is to protect wildlife, support conservation programs, and help visitors learn more about animals and their natural environments.

zooAnimals.animalDescription: Mufasa is a confident and powerful African lion. He was born in a wildlife conservation center and arrived at the zoo when he was two years old. Mufasa enjoys resting in the sun, playing with large enrichment toys, and watching visitors from his favorite rock. His keepers describe him as intelligent, calm, and very curious. His favorite food is beef.

Tantor is a gentle and friendly African elephant. He is highly social and has a close relationship with his keepers. He enjoys taking mud baths, playing with water, and using his trunk to explore new objects. Tantor can recognize several voice commands and loves receiving apples as a special treat. His daily diet includes grass, hay, vegetables, branches, and fruit.

Boog is an active and curious brown bear. He was rescued as a young cub after being found without his mother. He loves swimming, climbing wooden structures, and searching for food hidden by his keepers. Boog is especially energetic in the morning and usually sleeps during the warmest part of the day. His favorite foods are fish, berries, honey, nuts, and seasonal fruit.

Caesar is a playful and intelligent chimpanzee. He enjoys solving puzzles, climbing ropes, and communicating with other chimpanzees through sounds and gestures. Caesar is very observant and often copies the actions of his keepers. He has a cheerful personality and likes playing with cardboard boxes. His diet includes fruit, vegetables, seeds, nuts, and small amounts of protein.

Melman is a calm and elegant Masai giraffe. He is one of the tallest animals in the zoo and can easily reach leaves growing high above the ground. Melman enjoys spending time with other giraffes and is comfortable around his keepers. He is known for his gentle nature and distinctive dark spots. His favorite foods are acacia leaves, fresh branches, carrots, and lettuce.

Shere Khan is a strong and energetic Amur tiger. He was born in a wildlife conservation center and later moved to Baku Zoological Park. Shere Khan enjoys swimming, exploring his habitat, and playing with enrichment toys. Although he usually prefers to spend time alone, he has a calm relationship with his keepers. His favorite foods are beef, chicken, and other types of fresh meat.

Pink Floyd is a friendly and social greater flamingo. He spends most of his time together with the other flamingos near the water. Pink Floyd enjoys walking through shallow pools, cleaning his feathers, and resting on one leg. His beautiful pink color comes from the natural pigments in his food. He eats algae, seeds, small insects, and tiny crustaceans.

zooInfo: Tbilisi Zoological Park is one of the oldest and largest zoological parks in Georgia. Located in the country's capital, the zoo introduces visitors to animals from the Caucasus and many other regions of the world. Its work combines professional animal care, environmental education, scientific research, and the protection of rare species. The zoo pays special attention to wildlife native to Georgia and helps visitors understand why natural habitats and endangered animals must be protected.

zooAnimals.animalDescription: Aslan is a calm and confident white lion with a pale coat and a powerful build. He enjoys resting on warm rocks, walking around his territory, and watching visitors from the highest point of his habitat. His keepers describe him as observant, patient, and especially active in the early morning. Aslan takes part in enrichment activities that encourage his natural hunting behavior. His daily diet mainly includes carefully prepared portions of beef and poultry.

Dumbo is an intelligent and social Indian elephant who has built a trusting relationship with her keepers. She enjoys taking mud baths, spraying water with her trunk, and examining unfamiliar objects placed in her enclosure. Dumbo can recognize several voice commands and willingly participates in health checks. She spends much of her day walking, eating, and interacting with enrichment toys. Her diet includes hay, grass, fresh branches, vegetables, and small portions of fruit.

Rocksteady is a peaceful white rhinoceros with a curious and independent personality. Although he looks heavy and powerful, he moves carefully around his habitat and often follows familiar sounds made by his keepers. Rocksteady likes resting in soft sand, cooling himself in mud, and rubbing against large wooden posts. He is most active during the cooler hours of the day. His meals consist of grass, hay, leafy branches, and specially selected vegetables.

Bagheera is a quiet and agile Caucasian leopard with a mysterious and confident personality. He enjoys climbing tall platforms, moving through shaded areas, and observing everything around him from hidden places. His keepers prepare scent trails and hide food to encourage exploration and natural hunting skills. Bagheera usually prefers to spend time alone and becomes especially active in the evening. His diet includes fresh meat provided according to a carefully planned feeding schedule.

Gloria is a relaxed hippopotamus who spends a large part of the day resting in the water. She enjoys slowly walking along the bottom of her pool, spraying water, and sleeping in shaded areas during warm weather. In the evening, Gloria becomes more active and explores the land section of her habitat. Her keepers monitor her skin and teeth during regular health checks. She eats grass, hay, leafy vegetables, and other plant-based food.

Baloo is a friendly and curious Eurasian brown bear who enjoys exploring every corner of his habitat. He spends his mornings climbing wooden structures, swimming, and searching for food hidden by his keepers. Baloo is especially interested in boxes filled with leaves, branches, and unfamiliar scents. During warm afternoons, he usually rests in the shade or cools down in the water. His diet includes fish, vegetables, berries, nuts, honey, fruit, and carefully prepared portions of meat.

Zazu is a watchful golden eagle with excellent eyesight and powerful wings. He enjoys sitting on the highest branch in his aviary and carefully observing every movement below him. His keepers encourage natural behavior by placing food in different locations and introducing safe flying exercises. Zazu is calm around familiar people but remains cautious and independent. His diet consists of fresh meat, small prey items, and supplements selected to support healthy feathers and strong bones.

zooInfo: Polonezkoy Zoo is a nature-focused wildlife park located in the green Beykoz district of Istanbul. The park is surrounded by forest and gives visitors an opportunity to observe animals in spacious areas that resemble natural environments. Some peaceful species can move through open sections, while predators live in specially protected habitats. Guided activities, animal observation, and educational experiences help visitors learn about responsible care, biodiversity, and respect for wildlife.

zooAnimals.animalDescription: Geoffrey is a gentle Baringo giraffe with a calm personality and a distinctive pattern of dark spots. He enjoys walking through open areas, spending time near other giraffes, and reaching for leaves placed high above the ground. Geoffrey is comfortable around his keepers and approaches them during training and health checks. His long tongue helps him collect leaves from branches without damaging them. His favorite foods include acacia branches, lettuce, carrots, hay, and other fresh greens.

Akela is an alert and intelligent gray wolf who lives in a protected forest habitat. He communicates with the other wolves through body language, scent markings, and powerful howls that can be heard across the park. Akela enjoys following new smells, running along familiar paths, and searching for food hidden by his keepers. He is cautious around unfamiliar objects but quickly learns new routines. His diet contains carefully prepared portions of fresh meat and bones.

King Julien is a playful ring-tailed lemur who is easy to recognize by his long black-and-white tail. He enjoys jumping between branches, sitting in the sun, and communicating with his group through sounds and facial expressions. King Julien is curious about boxes, ropes, and food puzzles introduced by his keepers. He often carries pieces of food to a quiet platform before eating them. His diet includes fruit, vegetables, leaves, seeds, and small amounts of protein.

Nick Wilde is a quick and curious red fox with bright fur and a large bushy tail. He enjoys digging, following scent trails, and hiding small pieces of food in different parts of his habitat. Nick usually rests during the day and becomes more active when the temperature begins to fall. His keepers describe him as clever, careful, and very attentive to changes around him. He eats meat, eggs, insects, berries, fruit, and specially prepared supplements.

Kevin is an energetic common ostrich who enjoys running across the park's open territory. He is unable to fly, but his powerful legs allow him to move very quickly and defend himself when necessary. Kevin often investigates shiny objects and follows the movements of keepers from a safe distance. He spends time searching the ground for suitable food. His diet includes grasses, leaves, seeds, fruit, vegetables, and small insects.

Bambi is a gentle fallow deer who lives in one of the park's large open forest areas. He enjoys walking with the herd, resting beneath trees, and carefully approaching new objects placed by his keepers. Bambi is most active during the morning and evening when the weather is cooler. His spotted coat helps him blend naturally with sunlight and shadows between the trees. He eats grass, leaves, fresh branches, hay, vegetables, and small pieces of seasonal fruit.

Goatye West is an energetic mountain goat with excellent balance and a fearless personality. He enjoys climbing rocks, standing on narrow platforms, and reaching leaves that other animals cannot access. His keepers regularly change the climbing structures to keep him active and interested in his surroundings. Goatye West is social, confident, and always among the first animals to investigate fresh food. His diet includes grass, hay, leaves, branches, vegetables, and mineral supplements.

zooInfo: Sofia Zoo is the oldest and largest zoological garden in Bulgaria and is located in the country's capital. It is home to animals from many continents, including rare and endangered species cared for through international conservation programs. The zoo combines animal welfare, scientific work, public education, and environmental awareness. Its different zones introduce visitors to large mammals, primates, predators, birds, reptiles, amphibians, and aquatic life.

zooAnimals.animalDescription: Horton is a patient and intelligent Asian elephant who enjoys interacting with his keepers during daily training. He uses his trunk to examine objects, collect food, spray water, and communicate with other elephants. Horton particularly likes mud baths and large enrichment toys that require careful problem solving. Regular training allows the veterinary team to examine his feet, skin, and teeth safely. He eats hay, grass, fresh branches, vegetables, and carefully limited portions of fruit.

Rocky Balboa is a strong but peaceful white rhinoceros who prefers calm surroundings. He spends his mornings eating, walking through his habitat, and investigating scents left on trees and rocks. During warm afternoons, Rocky enjoys resting in the shade or covering his skin with protective mud. His keepers use positive training to monitor his health without causing unnecessary stress. His daily food consists mainly of hay, grass, leafy branches, and vegetables.

Tigger is a powerful Bengal tiger with a bright orange coat and dark individual stripes. He enjoys swimming, exploring dense vegetation, and following scent trails prepared by the animal care team. Tigger is usually solitary and spends part of the day resting in a quiet area away from visitors. He becomes especially focused when enrichment activities imitate natural hunting challenges. His meals include fresh meat and bones selected according to his nutritional and dental needs.

Tai Lung is a graceful snow leopard adapted to cold and mountainous environments. His thick fur, wide paws, and long tail help him move across rocks and maintain balance while climbing. Tai Lung enjoys resting on high platforms where he can quietly observe everything below him. His keepers hide food and introduce new scents to encourage natural movement and exploration. He eats carefully prepared portions of meat and receives regular veterinary examinations.

Flamingo Starr is a social greater flamingo who lives near the zoo's water area with the rest of his flock. He spends his time walking through shallow water, filtering food with his specially shaped beak, and carefully cleaning his feathers. Flamingo Starr often rests on one leg to conserve body heat and energy. His pink color comes from natural pigments contained in his food. He eats algae, seeds, small aquatic organisms, insects, and balanced supplements.

Alex is a confident and expressive African lion who enjoys being the center of attention. He spends much of the day resting with his pride but becomes highly active when new scents or enrichment toys appear. Alex likes walking through tall grass, stretching on large wooden platforms, and watching visitors from his favorite rock. His keepers describe him as intelligent, powerful, and surprisingly playful. His diet includes carefully measured portions of beef, poultry, and bones that help maintain healthy teeth and muscles.

Marty is a cheerful plains zebra with an individual stripe pattern that makes him easy to recognize. He enjoys running across the open habitat, staying close to the herd, and rolling in dry sand. Marty is curious about unfamiliar sounds and often approaches enrichment objects before the other zebras. His keepers monitor his hooves and teeth through regular positive training sessions. His daily food consists of grass, hay, leafy branches, vegetables, and specially balanced herbivore pellets.

zooInfo: Prague Zoo is a major zoological and conservation institution located in the Troja district of the Czech capital. Its large territory contains specialized habitats such as Elephant Valley, the Dja Reserve for gorillas, the African House, the Indonesian Jungle, and the Gharial House. The zoo participates in international breeding programs and supports wildlife conservation projects in different parts of the world. Its modern exhibits are designed to encourage natural behavior while helping visitors understand the environments animals depend on.

zooAnimals.animalDescription: Ellie is a friendly Indian elephant who lives with a family group in Elephant Valley. She enjoys walking long distances, bathing, covering her skin with sand, and using her trunk to solve food puzzles. Ellie learns quickly and cooperates with keepers during routine health checks. She communicates with the herd through touch, sound, and low-frequency calls that humans cannot always hear. Her diet includes hay, grass, bark, leafy branches, vegetables, and small portions of fruit.

King Kong is an intelligent western lowland gorilla who lives in a social family group. He enjoys climbing, examining natural materials, and watching the behavior of the other gorillas around him. King Kong can use simple tools and quickly understands enrichment activities that require patience and memory. His keepers describe him as calm, observant, and protective of younger group members. His diet contains leafy vegetables, branches, herbs, fruit, seeds, and small amounts of protein.

Tick-Tock is a long-snouted gharial specially adapted for catching fish in rivers. He spends much of his time resting in warm areas or moving slowly through the water with powerful strokes of his tail. Unlike broader-snouted crocodiles, his narrow jaws are designed to move quickly through water. Tick-Tock is usually calm and reacts carefully to activity around his habitat. His diet is based mainly on different types of fish and appropriate nutritional supplements.

Bridget is an elegant Rothschild's giraffe who lives in the African House. She enjoys calmly walking with the herd and using her long neck and tongue to reach leaves placed at different heights. Bridget is comfortable participating in simple training that helps keepers examine her body and hooves. Her unique spot pattern can be used to identify her from the other giraffes. She eats leafy branches, hay, fresh greens, carrots, and specially balanced giraffe food.

Ice Bear is a large and playful polar bear who enjoys swimming and investigating objects placed in his habitat. During warm weather, his keepers provide shade, cool water, and frozen enrichment containing pieces of food. Ice Bear uses his powerful paws to move toys, break ice, and pull objects from the pool. He often rests after swimming and becomes active again during feeding sessions. His diet includes fish, meat, and supplements prepared according to veterinary recommendations.

Moto Moto is a large and relaxed hippopotamus with a calm but confident personality. He spends most warm days resting in the pool, walking along the bottom, and occasionally spraying water across his habitat. In the evening, Moto Moto becomes more active and explores the land area in search of fresh food. His keepers regularly examine his skin, mouth, and powerful teeth. He eats grass, hay, leafy vegetables, and balanced plant-based food prepared according to his nutritional needs.

Blu is a bright and intelligent hyacinth macaw with deep blue feathers and a powerful curved beak. He enjoys flying between perches, opening puzzle feeders, and communicating with other parrots through loud calls. Blu quickly recognizes familiar keepers and often imitates sounds that attract his attention. His strong beak allows him to break hard nuts that many other birds cannot open. His diet includes nuts, seeds, fruit, vegetables, fresh branches, and carefully selected vitamin supplements.

zooInfo: Zoo Berlin is Germany's oldest zoological garden and is located in the center of the country's capital. It is internationally known for its exceptionally diverse animal collection and its work with endangered species. The zoo contains specialized environments for giant pandas, large cats, great apes, rhinoceroses, penguins, seals, and many other animals. Modern habitats, research, breeding programs, and worldwide conservation projects form an important part of its mission.

zooAnimals.animalDescription: Po is a calm giant panda who is one of the most recognized residents of Zoo Berlin. He spends many hours each day eating bamboo and carefully selecting the softest leaves and stems. Po also enjoys climbing, resting on wooden platforms, and exploring scents placed in his habitat. His keepers monitor his behavior, weight, and health as part of an international conservation program. Bamboo forms most of his diet, although he may also receive specially prepared panda food.

Donkey Kong is a gentle western lowland gorilla and one of the oldest residents of Zoo Berlin. Because of his advanced age, he prefers quiet surroundings and receives food that is easy to eat and carefully adapted to his needs. Donkey Kong enjoys leafy vegetables, herbs, and soft pieces of fruit while avoiding unnecessary sugar. His keepers closely monitor his movement, hearing, appetite, and comfort. He has a calm but independent personality and has formed strong relationships with the people who care for him.

Simba is a powerful African lion who lives as part of a social pride. He spends much of the day resting but becomes highly attentive when the group communicates or when enrichment is introduced. Simba enjoys following scent trails, moving through tall grass, and watching his surroundings from raised areas. His keepers use protected training to observe his health and behavior safely. He eats fresh meat and bones in portions planned to support his muscles, teeth, and overall condition.

Rajah is an athletic Sumatran tiger with a dark coat and closely spaced stripes. He enjoys moving through dense vegetation, swimming, and exploring hidden paths within his habitat. As a naturally solitary animal, Rajah prefers having several quiet spaces where he can rest without disturbance. His keepers provide scent enrichment, durable toys, and feeding challenges that encourage natural behavior. His diet consists of fresh meat, bones, and necessary veterinary supplements.

Skipper is a social king penguin who lives with a colony in a cool, carefully controlled environment. He enjoys swimming, following the other penguins, and standing close to the group while resting. Skipper can recognize familiar keepers and becomes excited when feeding time approaches. His streamlined body and strong flippers allow him to move gracefully through the water. He eats different species of fish selected to provide the energy and nutrients needed for healthy feathers.

Fiona is a friendly hippopotamus who enjoys spending hours swimming and resting beneath the surface of her pool. She often approaches the viewing area slowly and surprises visitors by moving through the water with remarkable grace. Fiona becomes more active later in the day when she walks onto land to eat. Her keepers use training to examine her mouth, teeth, skin, and general health. Her diet includes grass, hay, vegetables, leafy plants, and specially balanced herbivore pellets.

Flash is a calm two-toed sloth who moves through the trees at his own wonderfully slow pace. He spends much of the day hanging upside down, sleeping, and carefully selecting leaves within reach. Flash becomes more active in the evening and can move surprisingly well when he decides to change branches. His keepers monitor his claws, weight, digestion, and the condition of his fur. He eats leaves, vegetables, flowers, and small portions of fruit prepared especially for sloths.

zooInfo: Schonbrunn Zoo is located in Vienna within the historic Schonbrunn Palace gardens and is recognized as the oldest continuously operating zoo in the world. Today it combines its historic setting with modern habitats, scientific research, international breeding programs, and high standards of animal care. Visitors can discover hundreds of species representing tropical forests, mountain regions, polar environments, deserts, and aquatic ecosystems. Education and the protection of endangered wildlife are central parts of the zoo's work.

zooAnimals.animalDescription: Pan-Pan is an experienced and calm giant panda who has played an important role in the zoo's conservation work. She spends a large part of her day eating bamboo and resting in comfortable positions. Pan-Pan is selective about the branches she eats and carefully removes harder outer layers before reaching softer sections. Her keepers observe her appetite, movement, and behavior every day. Bamboo is her main food, together with small amounts of specially prepared panda nutrition.

Buster Moon is a quiet koala who spends most of his time resting among eucalyptus branches. Koalas conserve energy by sleeping for many hours because eucalyptus leaves provide relatively little energy and require specialized digestion. Buster becomes more active when fresh branches arrive and carefully selects leaves by smell. His keepers monitor the quality and variety of eucalyptus available to him. He receives fresh leaves every day and always has access to clean water.

King Louie is an intelligent Bornean orangutan with a thoughtful and curious personality. He enjoys climbing ropes, building comfortable nests, and solving puzzles that require him to use simple tools. King Louie carefully observes the actions of keepers and other orangutans and often discovers new solutions through patience. Enrichment activities change regularly to keep him mentally and physically active. His diet includes vegetables, leafy plants, fruit, seeds, nuts, and small amounts of protein.

Flipper is an energetic South American sea lion who enjoys swimming quickly, diving, and interacting with the other members of his group. During training, he follows visual signals that allow keepers to examine his eyes, teeth, flippers, and general condition. Flipper is playful and often carries floating objects around the pool. He can remain underwater for several minutes before returning to the surface. His diet includes herring, mackerel, and other nutritious fish.

Capy Potter is a calm and friendly capybara who lives in the zoo's South American area. He enjoys swimming, resting close to the water, and spending time with other members of his social group. Capy Potter uses water to cool down and to feel safe when something unfamiliar appears nearby. His keepers describe him as relaxed, observant, and strongly interested in fresh food. He eats grass, hay, leafy vegetables, aquatic plants, and specially balanced pellets.

Manny is a large and gentle African elephant with a protective and patient personality. He enjoys walking with the herd, moving heavy enrichment objects, taking mud baths, and collecting branches with his trunk. Manny responds calmly to familiar voice commands and participates in training that helps keepers monitor his feet, teeth, and general health. He is especially interested in fresh leaves and enjoys searching for food hidden around the habitat. His diet includes hay, grass, bark, branches, vegetables, and limited portions of fruit.

Mumble is a lively emperor penguin who is famous among his keepers for his unusual little dance-like steps. He enjoys swimming with the colony, diving after fish, and standing close to other penguins in the cooled habitat. Mumble recognizes feeding routines and quickly moves toward familiar keepers when food arrives. His thick feathers and layer of body fat help protect him from low temperatures. He eats fish and other seafood selected to provide enough energy for swimming and maintaining healthy feathers.

zooInfo: London Zoo is a historic wildlife park located in Regent's Park in the heart of the British capital. Founded in 1828, it is recognized as the world's oldest scientific zoo and today forms part of an international conservation organization. The zoo is home to thousands of animals, from tiny insects and reptiles to lions, tigers, penguins, and gorillas. Its modern habitats, educational programs, scientific research, and global conservation projects help visitors understand wildlife and the importance of protecting endangered species.

zooAnimals.animalDescription: Scar is a proud and watchful Asiatic lion with a thick mane and a confident personality. He enjoys resting on warm platforms, following scent trails, and observing the rest of his pride from elevated areas. Although he looks serious, Scar often plays with heavy enrichment balls and cardboard boxes provided by his keepers. Protected training allows the veterinary team to examine him safely. His diet consists of fresh meat and bones prepared according to a carefully balanced feeding plan.

Tarzan is an intelligent western lowland gorilla who combines impressive strength with a calm and thoughtful nature. He spends his day climbing, interacting with his family group, and solving food puzzles that encourage natural foraging behavior. Tarzan carefully watches his keepers and quickly learns new routines during voluntary health checks. He also enjoys building comfortable nests from branches and soft vegetation. His diet includes leafy vegetables, fruit, bark, seeds, and specially prepared primate food.

Rico is a lively Humboldt penguin who is always among the first members of his colony to enter the water. He swims quickly, dives after floating toys, and communicates with other penguins through energetic calls and body movements. Rico recognizes the familiar feeding routine and follows his keepers along the edge of the pool. Regular checks help protect his feet and waterproof feathers. His meals include herring, sprat, and other small fish enriched with essential vitamins.

Tony is an athletic Sumatran tiger with dark stripes and a highly curious personality. He enjoys moving through dense plants, climbing wooden structures, cooling down in the water, and investigating new scents placed around his habitat. Because tigers naturally live alone, Tony has several private areas where he can rest without interruption. His keepers use positive training to monitor his movement and health. He eats carefully measured portions of fresh meat, bones, and veterinary supplements.

Stretch Armstrong is a tall and gentle Rothschild's giraffe who can reach branches far above the other animals. He enjoys walking with his group, exploring hanging feeders, and carefully selecting the freshest leaves with his long tongue. Stretch participates calmly in training that helps keepers inspect his legs, hooves, and general condition. Visitors often recognize him by his light coat and irregular brown patches. His diet includes leafy branches, hay, vegetables, and balanced giraffe pellets.

Timon is a social and endlessly curious meerkat who often stands upright as the group's watchman. He enjoys digging tunnels, warming himself beneath the sun, and searching through sand for food hidden by his keepers. Timon communicates with the group using different calls that can warn of danger or announce something interesting. Despite his small size, he is confident and energetic. His diet includes insects, vegetables, eggs, seeds, and specially prepared portions of animal protein.

Sherlock is a clever Asian small-clawed otter who investigates every new object placed in his habitat. He uses his sensitive paws to search beneath stones, open puzzle feeders, and examine shells before entering the water for a fast swim. Sherlock is highly social and regularly communicates with the other otters through whistles and short calls. His keepers monitor his teeth, paws, and swimming activity. He eats fish, shrimp, shellfish, insects, and other protein-rich food.

zooInfo: Paris Zoological Park is a modern wildlife park situated beside the Bois de Vincennes in the French capital. The visitor route presents animals and plants through five large biozones inspired by Patagonia, Africa, Europe, Amazonia, and Madagascar. Natural landscapes, open viewpoints, and carefully planned habitats help people observe how different species interact with their environments. The park also supports scientific research, environmental education, breeding programs, and international projects dedicated to the conservation of threatened wildlife.

zooAnimals.animalDescription: Diego is a powerful jaguar with a golden coat covered in distinctive dark rosettes. He enjoys climbing, swimming, and quietly following scent trails through the tropical vegetation of his habitat. Diego usually rests during the middle of the day and becomes more active when the temperature begins to cool. His keepers provide hidden food and unfamiliar natural scents to stimulate exploration. His diet includes fresh meat, bones, and carefully selected supplements that support strong muscles and healthy teeth.

Baymax is a peaceful West Indian manatee with a gentle expression and an extremely relaxed swimming style. He slowly explores his large pool, rises regularly to breathe, and uses his flexible lips to collect floating plants. Baymax is curious about familiar keepers and participates calmly in training for health observations. Although his body is heavy, he moves gracefully underwater with the help of his broad tail. His diet includes lettuce, leafy vegetables, aquatic plants, and specially balanced supplements.

Maurice is a thoughtful ring-tailed lemur who prefers observing the group before joining its energetic games. He enjoys jumping between branches, warming himself in the morning sun, and carrying food to a quiet platform. His long black-and-white tail helps him remain visible while moving through vegetation with the other lemurs. Keepers regularly change ropes and puzzle feeders to encourage activity. Maurice eats fruit, leaves, vegetables, seeds, and small portions of insects and protein.

Rhino McQueen is a confident white rhinoceros who can move surprisingly quickly when something captures his attention. He spends much of the day grazing, resting in soft sand, and covering his skin with cooling mud. Large wooden posts allow him to scratch safely, while hidden food encourages him to explore the entire habitat. His keepers monitor his feet, skin, weight, and horn condition during regular training. He eats grass, hay, leafy branches, vegetables, and balanced herbivore pellets.

Puss in Boots is an agile puma with a quiet step, excellent balance, and a surprisingly playful personality. He enjoys climbing rocky ledges, resting in shaded places, and watching movement from the highest platform in his habitat. Scent trails and hidden feeding points encourage him to use his natural tracking skills. Puss usually prefers solitude but responds calmly to familiar keepers during protected training. His diet consists of fresh meat, bones, and nutritional supplements recommended by the veterinary team.

Barbie is an elegant greater flamingo whose bright pink feathers make her easy to recognize within the flock. She spends her day walking through shallow water, filtering food with her curved beak, and carefully cleaning her feathers. Barbie is social and usually rests close to the other flamingos, sometimes standing on one leg for long periods. Keepers monitor the flock's water quality and nutrition. Her diet includes algae, seeds, tiny crustaceans, insects, and specially prepared flamingo food.

Aquaman is an energetic South American sea lion who moves through the water with speed and remarkable control. He enjoys diving, chasing floating toys, and interacting with other members of his social group. During training, Aquaman voluntarily presents his flippers, eyes, and mouth so keepers can examine his health without stress. He is confident, vocal, and especially excited before feeding time. His daily meals include herring, mackerel, and other nutritious fish supplemented with vitamins.

zooInfo: Zoo Aquarium de Madrid is a large zoological park located in the green Casa de Campo area of Spain's capital. Its grounds combine a traditional zoo, a public aquarium, a large aviary, and educational spaces representing wildlife from five continents. Visitors can discover hundreds of species while learning about their behavior, ecosystems, and the threats they face in nature. The zoo participates in breeding, research, rescue, and conservation programs and uses educational activities to encourage respect for animals and their habitats.

zooAnimals.animalDescription: Panda Express is a relaxed giant panda who becomes surprisingly quick whenever fresh bamboo arrives. He spends many hours eating, climbing low wooden structures, and sleeping in comfortable shaded areas. Using his strong paws and wrist bones, he holds bamboo securely while removing the harder outer layers. His keepers monitor his weight, appetite, teeth, and daily activity as part of the zoo's conservation work. Bamboo forms most of his diet, together with specially prepared panda cakes and small seasonal treats.

Echo is a social bottlenose dolphin who communicates through whistles, clicks, and body movements. She enjoys swimming with the group, investigating floating objects, and participating in voluntary training that supports physical exercise and veterinary care. Echo uses echolocation to understand her surroundings and can identify objects without relying only on sight. Her keepers regularly examine her breathing, skin, teeth, and movement. She eats several species of fish and squid provided in carefully measured portions throughout the day.

Babar is an intelligent Sumatran elephant with a gentle personality and a strong connection to his herd. He enjoys mud baths, water sprays, long walks, and moving heavy enrichment objects with his trunk. Babar follows familiar voice signals during protected training, allowing keepers to inspect his feet, mouth, and overall condition. Food is placed around the habitat to encourage natural movement and foraging. His diet includes hay, grass, leafy branches, bark, vegetables, and limited portions of fruit.

Koalvin Klein is a calm koala who always appears perfectly comfortable while resting between eucalyptus branches. He sleeps for many hours to conserve energy and becomes most active when fresh leaves are delivered. Koalvin carefully smells different branches before choosing the leaves he wants to eat. His keepers check the quality and variety of eucalyptus every day and monitor his weight and digestion. His specialized diet consists almost entirely of fresh eucalyptus leaves, with clean water always available.

Curious George is a clever Bornean orangutan who examines every new puzzle, rope, and container introduced to his habitat. He enjoys climbing high platforms, building sleeping nests, and using simple tools to reach hidden treats. George pays close attention to his keepers and often discovers solutions by patiently watching their movements. Changing enrichment keeps his mind and body active throughout the day. His diet includes vegetables, leafy plants, fruit, seeds, nuts, and small amounts of protein.

Paddington is a curious brown bear who loves exploring, swimming, and searching for food hidden around his spacious habitat. He uses his powerful paws to move logs, open sturdy boxes, and dig through piles of leaves. Although he is large, Paddington often handles unfamiliar objects with surprising care. During hot weather, he spends extra time resting in the shade or cooling down in water. His varied diet includes fish, meat, vegetables, berries, nuts, honey, and seasonal fruit.

Neckolas Cage is an elegant Rothschild's giraffe who enjoys peaceful walks and feeding beside the other members of his group. His height allows him to reach fresh leaves placed far above the ground, while his long tongue helps pull them safely from branches. Neckolas participates in calm training sessions that allow keepers to inspect his hooves and general health. He is observant and often approaches unfamiliar enrichment slowly. His meals include leafy branches, hay, vegetables, and balanced giraffe pellets.

zooInfo: Bioparco di Roma is a historic zoological garden situated within Villa Borghese near the center of the Italian capital. The park combines mature trees, natural landscapes, modern animal habitats, and educational areas designed for visitors of different ages. Its collection includes mammals, birds, reptiles, and amphibians from many parts of the world, including several threatened species. Conservation breeding, scientific research, wildlife protection, and environmental education are central to the Bioparco's mission and its transformation into a modern conservation-focused zoo.

zooAnimals.animalDescription: Tony Montana is a confident Sumatran tiger whose powerful appearance is matched by excellent agility and patience. He enjoys patrolling paths through dense vegetation, climbing raised platforms, and cooling himself in the water. New scents, hanging objects, and hidden feeding points encourage Tony to investigate the entire habitat. As a naturally solitary cat, he also has several quiet areas for private rest. His diet consists of fresh meat, bones, and veterinary supplements provided according to a carefully planned schedule.

Maximus is a powerful Asiatic lion with a calm presence and the attitude of a true Roman emperor. He spends warm afternoons resting with his pride and becomes more active during the cooler morning and evening hours. Maximus enjoys scent trails, durable enrichment toys, and observing his surroundings from a raised rock. Protected training helps keepers monitor his movement, teeth, and general condition. His meals include fresh meat and bones in portions designed to maintain strength and healthy body weight.

Rocky Roma is a peaceful white rhinoceros who spends much of his day grazing and walking between sunny and shaded areas. He loves covering his skin with mud, which helps him remain cool and offers protection from insects. Rocky investigates large enrichment objects with his horn and enjoys rubbing against strong wooden posts. His keepers use calm training to inspect his feet and skin. He eats grass, hay, leafy branches, vegetables, and nutritionally balanced herbivore pellets.

Luca is a playful California sea lion who seems happiest while racing through the water or carrying floating toys around his pool. He is highly social, vocal, and always attentive when familiar keepers approach. Voluntary training keeps Luca active and allows the veterinary team to examine his eyes, mouth, skin, and flippers without causing unnecessary stress. He can dive and change direction with impressive speed. His diet includes herring, mackerel, squid, and other nutritious seafood.

Mario is an energetic Asian small-clawed otter who turns every feeding activity into a new adventure. He enjoys swimming through narrow channels, searching under rocks, and using his sensitive front paws to open puzzle feeders. Mario communicates constantly with his family group through whistles, chirps, and quick movements. Keepers regularly introduce shells and hidden food to encourage natural problem-solving behavior. His diet includes fish, shrimp, shellfish, insects, and carefully selected portions of other animal protein.

Pingu is a sociable African penguin who enjoys swimming with the colony and resting beside his favorite rocky shelter. He uses distinctive calls to communicate with his partner and becomes especially lively when feeding time approaches. Pingu's streamlined body and powerful flippers make him much faster in water than on land. Keepers monitor his weight, feet, and waterproof feathers during regular checks. He eats small fish such as herring and sprat, together with nutritional supplements when required.

Remus is an alert Eurasian gray wolf whose name recalls one of the legendary founders of Rome. He lives within a social pack and communicates through posture, scent markings, facial expressions, and powerful howls. Remus enjoys following trails, running through wooded areas, and searching for food placed in changing locations. He remains cautious around unfamiliar objects but learns routines quickly. His diet contains fresh meat, bones, and whole prey items selected to support natural feeding behavior.

zooInfo: Budapest Zoo and Botanical Garden is a historic wildlife institution located in the City Park of Hungary's capital. Opened in 1866, it is the country's oldest zoo and combines animal habitats with valuable botanical collections and distinctive historic architecture. Visitors can explore species from tropical forests, African savannas, polar regions, wetlands, and many other ecosystems. The zoo supports conservation breeding, wildlife rescue, scientific study, and public education while preserving an important part of Budapest's cultural and natural heritage.

zooAnimals.animalDescription: Jumbo is a patient Asian elephant who enjoys walking with his herd, bathing, and using his trunk to investigate new enrichment objects. He can move heavy logs with ease but handles small pieces of food with remarkable precision. Jumbo responds calmly to protected training that allows keepers to inspect his feet, mouth, and skin. Food is distributed throughout the habitat to encourage daily movement and natural foraging. His diet includes hay, grass, bark, branches, vegetables, and limited amounts of fruit.

Hulk is a strong western lowland gorilla whose serious appearance hides a calm and protective personality. He spends time with his family group, climbs sturdy structures, builds sleeping nests, and solves puzzles prepared by his keepers. Hulk pays close attention to changes in his environment and often examines unfamiliar objects before allowing younger gorillas to approach. Voluntary training supports regular health observations. His diet includes leafy vegetables, branches, fruit, seeds, nuts, and specially balanced primate food.

Snowball is a powerful polar bear who enjoys swimming, diving, and pushing large floating objects around his pool. His dense fur, strong paws, and thick layer of body fat are natural adaptations for life in cold environments. Keepers provide changing scents, hidden food, ice blocks, and durable toys to keep him physically and mentally active. Snowball also has quiet spaces where he can rest away from visitors. His diet includes fish, meat, bones, and carefully controlled nutritional supplements.

Master Shifu is an agile red panda with a striped tail, careful movements, and a calm but independent personality. He spends much of his time climbing branches, resting in elevated shelters, and exploring when the air becomes cooler. His semi-retractable claws and flexible ankles help him move safely through the trees. Keepers place food at different heights to encourage natural activity. His diet is based on bamboo and also includes leaves, vegetables, fruit, and specially prepared food for red pandas.

Orangina is a curious Sumatran orangutan who uses patience, intelligence, and strong hands to solve difficult feeding puzzles. She enjoys climbing ropes, building leafy nests, and observing both visitors and keepers from high platforms. Orangina often uses simple tools to reach food and remembers successful solutions for later activities. Regularly changing enrichment supports her physical and mental well-being. Her diet includes leafy vegetables, fruit, seeds, nuts, branches, and small portions of protein prepared by the animal-care team.

Crocodile Dundee is a large Nile crocodile who spends long periods resting almost motionless beside the water. Despite his quiet appearance, he can react with impressive speed and uses powerful jaws to capture food. Dundee regulates his body temperature by moving between warm basking areas, shade, and water. Keepers observe him from protected positions and carefully monitor his appetite, movement, teeth, and skin. His diet includes fish, poultry, and other meat provided according to a controlled feeding schedule.

Tallulah is a graceful Rothschild's giraffe who enjoys browsing leafy branches and staying close to the other members of her group. Her excellent height and long tongue allow her to reach food that many animals cannot access. Tallulah approaches familiar keepers calmly and participates in training used to inspect her hooves and general health. Hanging feeders encourage her to stretch and move naturally throughout the day. Her meals include fresh branches, hay, leafy vegetables, and nutritionally balanced giraffe pellets.
